english.title: Fail to deliver defaced, lost or mislaid hackney carriage badge to Transport for London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person who had possessed or come into the possession of a badge issued under the authority of the London Hackney Carriages Act 1843 and
(A)_[on which the writing had become obliterated or defaced, so that it was not distinctly legible,]_
(B)_[which was proved to the satisfaction of Transport for London to have been lost or mislaid,]_

refused or neglected for three days to deliver the same to Transport for London
english.legislation: Contrary to section 19 of the London Hackney Carriages Act 1843.
